concept_uz: Jala, tungi aeroport, reys bekor qilingan. Yonidagi toʻqiyotgan kampir notanish yigitga soyabonini beradi. Burilish: bir paytlar unga ham notanish odam soyabon bergan va «bir kun boshqa birovga bering» degan — u oʻshandan beri sumkasida ortiqcha soyabon olib yuradi. Endi yigit ham shunday qiladi.

facts.claim: Hikoyachi oʻn yildan beri ish bilan uchadi, uni kam narsa ajablantiradi
Ulanuvchi reysi ogohlantirishsiz bekor qilingan, tashqarida jala; u 14-gate yonida oʻtirgan
Yaqinda oʻtirgan keksa ayol xotirjam toʻqib oʻtirgan va qoʻngandan keyin uyga qanday borishini soʻragan; mashinasi boshqa aeroportda qolgan
Ayol kichik yigʻma soyabonni berib, «uyga hoʻl boʻlib bormang» degan; u rad etmoqchi boʻlgan
Yillar oldin boʻronda qolganida notanish odam unga soyabon bergan, qaytib olmagan va «bir kun boshqa birovga bering» degan; oʻshandan beri u sumkasida ortiqcha soyabon olib yurgan
U oʻsha kechasi soatlab kechikib uchgan va yomgʻirda uning soyabonidan foydalangan
Endi oʻzi ham sumkasida ortiqcha soyabon olib yuradi va uni ikki marta notanish odamlarga bergan

style_line: Cinematic photoreal drama, rainy night, cool blue-grey light from windows and screens against warm amber lamps, glistening wet reflections, soft film grain, 35mm look, quiet tender mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

lines.text: Oʻn yildan beri ish bilan uchaman. Meni hech narsa ajablantirmaydi, deb oʻylardim.

scenes.prompt: A crack of thunder; rain hammers the huge dark windows of the night terminal. Slow push-in down the empty waiting hall toward a quiet gate, where the departure board flickers and rows of blurred red lights blink. Audio: thunder, heavy rain on glass, a soft airport chime, a tired murmur of passengers. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "O'n yildan beri ish bilan uchaman. Meni hech narsa ajablantirmaydi, deb o'ylardim." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oʻsha kechasi reysim bekor qilindi. Tashqarida jala quyardi.

scenes.prompt: Medium shot: the traveller in the navy raincoat and grey scarf drops into a seat near the gate, rubs his face, and stares at the rain-streaked window. Audio: rain, a distant announcement chime, his long sigh. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "O'sha kechasi reysim bekor qilindi. Tashqarida jala quyardi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oʻgʻlim, qoʻnganingizdan keyin uyga qanday borasiz?

scenes.prompt: The elderly woman in the lavender shawl knits calmly, needles clicking, completely at peace amid the chaos; she glances over her round glasses at the traveller and asks him kindly. He turns, surprised, and answers with a tired half-smile. Audio: knitting needles clicking, rain. The elderly woman asks in Uzbek with a soft, kind, unhurried elderly Uzbek female voice, about seventy, gently smiling: "O'g'lim, qo'nganingizdan keyin uyga qanday borasiz?" The man answers in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "Mashinam boshqa aeroportda. Ivib ketaman-da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Mana, oling. Uyga hoʻl boʻlib bormang.

scenes.prompt: Without hesitating, the elderly woman takes a small folded umbrella from her knitting bag and presses it into his hands; he lifts his palms to refuse, she gently pushes his hands closed around it. Audio: rain, the soft rustle of the bag. The elderly woman says in Uzbek with a soft, kind, unhurried elderly Uzbek female voice, about seventy, gently smiling: "Mana, oling. Uyga ho'l bo'lib bormang." The man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "Yo'q-yo'q, kerak emas..." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir paytlar men ham boʻronda qolganman. Notanish odam soyabonini berdi-yu, qaytib olmadi.

scenes.prompt: Soft, faded memory: in a night storm on an old city street, the young woman stands soaked and shivering under a shop awning; a stranger, seen only from behind in a dark coat, holds a black umbrella over her and puts it in her hand, then walks away into the rain without it. Audio: storm, rain on the umbrella, fading footsteps. An off-screen elderly woman says in Uzbek with a soft, kind, unhurried elderly Uzbek female voice, about seventy, gently smiling: "Bir paytlar men ham bo'ronda qolganman. Notanish odam soyabonini berdi-yu, qaytib olmadi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: U faqat dedi: bir kun buni boshqa birovga bering. Oʻshandan beri sumkamda doim ortiqcha soyabon yuradi.

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the elderly woman back in the terminal, holding the traveller's gaze with a small, warm smile, her hand resting on her knitting bag. Audio: rain, the needles still for a moment. The elderly woman says in Uzbek with a soft, kind, unhurried elderly Uzbek female voice, about seventy, gently smiling: "U faqat dedi: bir kun buni boshqa birovga bering. O'shandan beri sumkamda doim ortiqcha soyabon yuradi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Soatlab kechikib uchdim. Lekin uyga quruq bordim — uning soyabonida.

scenes.prompt: Night, wet street, glowing puddles. The traveller walks home slowly under the small umbrella, rain pouring around him, and looks up at it with a quiet smile. Audio: rain drumming on the umbrella, distant traffic. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "Soatlab kechikib uchdim. Lekin uyga quruq bordim — uning soyabonida." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Endi mening sumkamda ham ortiqcha soyabon bor. Hozircha uni ikki marta berdim.

scenes.prompt: Some time later, rain at a bus stop: the traveller, the same grey scarf, takes a spare folded umbrella from his own bag and holds it out to a soaked, tired young student, who hesitates, then takes it. Audio: rain, a passing bus. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "Endi mening sumkamda ham ortiqcha soyabon bor. Hozircha uni ikki marta berdim." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Kichik yaxshilik siz bilan tugashi shart emas. Sizga kim soyabon tutgan? Izohda yozing.

scenes.prompt: Continue: the student opens the umbrella and walks off into the rain; the traveller, now wet, turns his face to the camera and smiles, rain on his cheeks. Hold on the smile. Audio: rain softening. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a calm, slightly tired Uzbek male voice, about thirty-five, quiet and sincere: "Kichik yaxshilik siz bilan tugashi shart emas. Sizga kim soyabon tutgan? Izohda yozing." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
